chapter: Boyhood in Evergreen and Calhoun school
title: His brother Von and the Greek lady who named him
summary: Autrey is the first child and Von the only other; a Greek family friend of his mother named Von.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And you were born in Evergreen. How many more came after you?
Well, it's a complicated thing. It's Le Von Autrey, but there's then some before that, you know.
Yeah, a Greek lady named him.
Why was he named by a Greek lady?

Well, she was a very good friend of my mother. They were, for years they were friends. She'd come to my house and sit on the step with my mother, and she would -- they would talk, and she'd bring a basket. Always I can see it was a little basket now on her arm, and she'd have some goodies in there. Each time she came -- some kind of cake, candies or something she had made and she wanted my mother to taste it, and every so often my mother would pick out a day she would go to her house and take me along, you know, and they would sit and talk for a couple of hours. I don't know what they were talking about.
I would be looking for someplace to play, but they were very, very good friends.
